correctness.rationale: Read immutable RESULT.md and verify.cpp. Affine [16,5,8] code has 11 parity-check rows from pivot coordinates 0,1,2,4,8; pair of 11-bit syndromes labels every ordered coset pair. At each of 16 positions two binary errors give precisely four transitions of minimum joint union-support: D_{j+1}(s)=min(D_j(s),1+D_j(s+e_j),1+D_j(s+f_j),1+D_j(s+e_j+f_j)). This inductive recurrence is exhaustive on 2^22 syndromes. Independently implemented recurrence in C++17, executed all 4,194,304 states and recovered exact histogram (1,48,1080,15120,144585,858144,2359602,798000,17388,336), first distance-nine syndrome=(373,207), total 4194304 and radius nine. First four counts also equal binom(16,j)3^j (j=0..3) because minimum codeword support eight, independent consistency check. This proves the finite fixed-code statement, NOT an infinite Reed–Muller family or orbit classification.
